title: (Revival) Part 5 - Glory of God
description: In this sermon, the preacher discusses the concept of revival and reawakening in the church. He emphasizes the importance of understanding what happens when God graciously visits his people with revival. The preacher shares a personal experience of encountering the glory of God and being overwhelmed by His grace and love. He then explores Moses' request to see God's glory and how Moses was still not satisfied, despite having already experienced remarkable encounters with God. The sermon highlights the insatiable desire for more of God's presence and the longing to be emptied and filled with Christ alone.
